scope.description: Local RawNode ReadOnlySafe singleton self-certification after committed/applied simple membership change; live removed instances remain callable with StepDownOnRemoval disabled.
assumptions: Serialized RawNode calls and contract-compliant persistence/application.
Unique request context and no earlier read or heartbeat acknowledgement associated with that context.
No caller policy retires the RawNode before the selected invocation.
excluded: Guarantee that every read request returns
External application read completion or client linearizability violation
Deployments which stop removed instances before invoking reads

properties.reason: Independent applicability, correlated prerequisites and fully observed result comparison

adaptations: No target logic edits; internal voter maps and role are read-only observations.
MemoryStorage substitutes for noncrashing disk persistence.
A string register is the explicit application model; it applies normal payloads and committed configuration entries in index order.
Removed RawNode remains callable intentionally, excluding external retirement policy.

plan_uncertainties: The initial snapshot prefix is supplied consistently, not executed from process birth.
No physical disk crash, application-served stale read or external client linearizability endpoint is observed.
Deployments that retire removed instances avoid the selected invocation.
